keyFindings.description: smoke_pr: gh pr list --limit 100 has no truncation guard; a 100-entry list with exactly one legion/<KEY> entry is picked silently (reproduced with a fake gh), and the 0-case remedy misleads when the candidate is older than the newest 100. Fix: fail when 100 are listed (mirror pr_commits) or paginate with gh api --paginate repos/<repo>/pulls?state=all; add a 100-entry PR_LIST_OUTPUT harness case; name the window in the comment and README paragraph.

errexit is not inherited into $(...): a failing gh inside pr_commits or smoke_pr continues on an empty string and the CHECKPOINT line names a condition that did not happen (502 on the commits endpoint -> 'PR #7 has no commits (0 listed)'; 401 on pr list -> 'has  legion/<KEY> pull requests: ;'). Never a false OK. Fix: '|| fail "gh api ... failed"' on the line-245 substitution and '|| fail "gh pr list ... failed"' on line 224; pr_reviews needs nothing (pipefail is inherited).

fastFollow: scripts/smoke checkpoint wording and duplication cleanup: hoist the login-membership jq def shared by commit_faults and checkpoint 7's deletion check; README row 5 overclaims that the trailer names the committing pane's session (only the UUID shape is asserted); README rows 7/8 list SMOKE_PR as required while the paragraph says discovery applies to 5, 7, 8; pr_commits' 'nothing was checked' is false from checkpoint 7; no negative case for 'SMOKE_PR must be a pull request number' or 'SMOKE_REVIEWER_LOGIN is required' on checkpoint 5.
